statement: A two-scale packet grid has only 4L nodes, contains every port difference, has uniform derivative valuations and integral shifted Cauchy kernels for an arbitrary dyadic gap. Its normalized local Cauchy Smith valuations are exactly 4j-2 popcount(j)+2(b-r) floor(j/d). A complete changed recovery/mode schedule and a SAT time improvement are not established.
